tools.name: search_pubmed
tools.description: Search PubMed for biomedical literature. Returns article summaries with PMIDs, titles, authors, journals, and DOIs.

tools.name: search_europepmc
tools.description: Search Europe PMC — a broader biomedical corpus than PubMed that also indexes preprints (bioRxiv, medRxiv), patents, and agricultural/biomedical databases. Unlike search_pubmed, each result includes a

tools.name: get_abstract
tools.description: Get the full structured abstract and metadata for a PubMed article. Returns abstract sections (background, methods, results, conclusions), keywords, MeSH terms, and PMC ID.

tools.name: get_full_text
tools.description: Get the full text of an open-access article from PubMed Central. Returns article sections, figure/table captions, and reference count. Only works for articles available in PMC.

tools.name: find_related
tools.description: Find related articles for a given PubMed article. Returns similar papers ranked by relevance score using PubMed's neighbor algorithm.

tools.name: format_citation
tools.description: Format a citation for a PubMed article in APA, Vancouver, Harvard, or BibTeX style.

tools.name: trending_papers
tools.description: Find recent/trending papers on a topic. Sorted by date, with optional filtering to high-impact journals.

tools.name: get_uspi
tools.description: Get FDA US Prescribing Information (USPI) for a drug from openFDA (cited to DailyMed). Returns structured labelling sections with LOINC codes, verbatim. Long sections are paged: a cut section has trun

tools.name: get_smpc
tools.description: Get UK/EU Summary of Product Characteristics (SmPC) for a drug from eMC (medicines.org.uk). Returns structured labelling sections, verbatim. Long sections are paged: a cut section has truncated: true,

tools.name: compare_labels
tools.description: Compare US FDA Prescribing Information vs UK/EU SmPC for a drug side-by-side. Maps equivalent sections (e.g., US Indications ↔ UK 4.1) and returns paired verbatim content. A missing side is always exp

tools.name: search_by_indication
tools.description: Find drugs approved for a medical condition. Searches US FDA labelling for the condition, then checks UK (eMC) availability for each drug found.

tools.name: resolve_drug_name
tools.description: Convert a brand drug name to its generic name (or a generic to its US brand names), with drug class and common indications. Deterministic — sourced from RxNorm/openFDA, no AI.

tools.name: search_trials
tools.description: Search ClinicalTrials.gov for clinical trials. Filter by condition, intervention, status, and phase. Returns trial summaries with NCT IDs, status, sponsors, and enrollment info.

tools.name: get_trial
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific clinical trial from ClinicalTrials.gov. Returns eligibility criteria, study design, arms, outcomes, locations, and associated PubMed IDs.
